activities.name: Get out of bed
activities.description: Get my body physically out of bed at least one time during the day.

activities.name: RUN: Step outside at least once during the day for BDNF and Morning Light
activities.description: BDNF and Morning Light. Ultimate goal is 20 minutes jog every day morning to get that BDNF, norepinephrine, and hormone/neurotransmitter cocktail that sets me up for a great day. A success is defined as putting on my running clothes and stepping outside with them. That's it. Ridiculously easy. If it's raining I don't have to run.

activities.name: Drink 2 spoonfuls of Olive Oil = 400 cals
activities.description: This gives me a nice quick 400 calories to start my day. 15 ml of olive oil is 120 calories. This is 8 calories per ml. So a 25 ml spoonful is 200 calories, and two of these is 400 calories.

activities.name: Drink roughly at least 1 orange water bottle

activities.name: Emotion Processing Course Video for today
Brush teeth before bed
activities.description: Having a set time to brush my teeth will be good for me because it will trigger the routine for me to go to sleep and get good sleep to be ready for the day ahead tomorrow. This set time is ideally 9:30pm, but at the moment since my schedule is so variable I'm just going to aim for that implicitly but not codify it explicitly. Plus, I made it a new years resolution to brush me teeth every day at night, so this is how I'll keep myself accountable. I want to be the person who is consistent with his hygiene. Being gross is gross and *definitely* not esteemable.

activities.name: Review List(s) of Goals
activities.description:
Look through all lists of goals I have. Read each goal, have a think about where I am in respect to each one. Add new goals, remove goals that don't align anymore, tweak goals that need tweaking. Set my focus on the prize once again, for it's likely that it may have drifted. The minimum I have to do is read them over.

Reorient if need be.
